RESEARCH / OUR DIRECTION

Better questions.
Meaningful evidence.

A proposed research agenda for AI that supports learning, strengthens teaching and earns trust.

01 / LEARNING SCIENCES

AI that supports deeper learning

Explore how guided questioning, feedback and reflection can help students build understanding rather than simply obtain answers.

02 / TEACHER PRACTICE

Teachers in the loop

Investigate lesson planning, differentiated resources and formative assessment with educators retaining professional judgement.

03 / RESPONSIBLE AI

Trust, access and agency

Examine accuracy, bias, privacy and equitable access through classroom scenarios and practical evaluation methods.

HOW WE EXPLORE

Grounded in the classroom.

  1. Define the learning need

    Start with a real educational question and a clear learning objective.

  2. Co-design and evaluate

    Develop activities with educators and assess learning quality, usability and access.

  3. Reflect and share

    Document limitations, review unintended effects and share useful findings.

Research themes describe the platform’s intended direction. Published studies and partnerships will be added when available.
